text:
```yaml
name: NuGet Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - release
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - release

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '5.0'

    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build and test
      run: dotnet build --configuration Release /p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true && dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

    - name: Determine version
      if: github.ref != 'refs/tags/v*.*.*'
      run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target determine-version --configuration Release

    - name: Update version
      if: github.ref != 'refs/tags/v*.*.*'
      run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target update-version --configuration Release

    - name: Push to NuGet
      if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*.*.*' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
      run: dotnet build ./build/Program.cs --target push-to-nuget --configuration Release
      env:
        NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }}

    - name: Archive artifacts
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: artifacts
        path: artifacts/
```
